grade_rationale: 5 P1 CVEs — exceeds C threshold (max_p1: 2). Grade D by inspector.config.yml grading table. Upgrade vitest + jest + proxy-addr to clear all P1s and target grade B.

escalations.title: Handlebars.js — 10 CVEs, Remote Code Execution (CVSS 9.8)
escalations.detail: jest@29.7.0 transitively pulls handlebars@4.x with 10 CVEs including RCE via AST type confusion and prototype pollution

escalations.title: proxy-addr — IPv4-Mapped IPv6 IP Spoofing / Authentication Bypass (CVSS 9.1)
escalations.detail: proxy-addr <2.0.8 allows IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses to bypass IP whitelist access controls. RUNTIME vulnerability in production backend.

escalations.title: vitest@2.0.5 — Arbitrary File Read + RCE via UI Server (CVSS 9.8)
escalations.detail: Direct dependency vitest@2.0.5 allows arbitrary file reads and RCE when vitest --ui is running. Any network user can exploit without authentication.
escalations.escalation_reason: Arbitrary file read + RCE — direct dependency

escalations.title: tinypool — Prototype Pollution → Remote Code Execution
escalations.detail: Prototype pollution via tinypool worker initialization options allows RCE during test execution. Resolved by vitest upgrade.
escalations.fix: npm install vitest@^5.0.3 in Source/Frontend (resolves DEP-003 and DEP-004 together)

escalations.title: @babel/core — Arbitrary File Read via sourceMappingURL
escalations.detail: Crafted sourceMappingURL comments cause @babel/core to read arbitrary files from the build host during compilation.
escalations.fix: Upgrade @babel/core to latest in Source/Backend and Source/Frontend
escalations.escalation_reason: File read during build — affects both backend and frontend

backlog.title: Missing seed.ts — FR-dependency-seed unimplemented
backlog.detail: FR-dependency-seed requires idempotent seed with 8 known dependency relationships on startup. File does not exist. Acceptance criterion GET /api/bugs/BUG-0010 returns 5 items in blocked_by is unmet.
backlog.fix: Create portal/Backend/src/database/seed.ts with idempotent inserts guarded by existence check; call from portal/Backend/src/index.ts startup after initSchema()

backlog.title: as any type-safety bypass in DependencyPicker — FR-dependency-api-types incomplete
backlog.detail: UpdateBugInput and UpdateFeatureRequestInput in portal/Shared/api.ts lack blocked_by?: string[]. DependencyPicker uses as any casts to work around this, silencing type errors on PATCH payloads.
backlog.fix: Add blocked_by?: string[] to both UpdateBugInput and UpdateFeatureRequestInput in portal/Shared/api.ts, then remove the two as any casts from DependencyPicker.tsx

backlog.title: Dispatch gating returns HTTP 400 instead of status=pending_dependencies
backlog.detail: FR-dependency-dispatch-gating acceptance criterion: PATCH to approved with unresolved blocker → 200 with status=pending_dependencies. Implementation returns HTTP 400 and never sets status. WorkItemStatus enum has no PendingDependencies value.
backlog.fix: Option A: Add PendingDependencies = 'pending_dependencies' to WorkItemStatus, update VALID_STATUS_TRANSITIONS, change dispatch logic to set status instead of returning 400. Option B: Update spec to reflect 400-rejection approach. Coordinate with api-contract agent before touching shared types.

backlog.title: teamDispatches.ts — unlinked implementation with zero Verifies comments
backlog.detail: Recently-modified file implements team dispatch history API with zero // Verifies: traceability comments. No specification claims this feature. Violates Specs → Plans → Source workflow.
backlog.fix: Write FR in Specifications/ for team dispatch history feature AND add // Verifies: FR-XXX comments, OR remove the implementation until spec is written.

backlog.title: browserslist — Unbounded Memory Growth DoS
backlog.detail: browserslist <=4.28.6 has no cache eviction causing OOM on distinct queries. Also vulnerable to crash via malicious browserslist-stats.json.
backlog.fix: Resolved automatically when vitest is upgraded to ^5.0.3 (transitive dep). Verify with npm ls browserslist.

backlog.title: @vitest/mocker — Path Traversal / Arbitrary File Read
backlog.detail: Path traversal via redirect mock allows reading arbitrary files from filesystem. Affects vitest >=2.1.0 <4.1.11.
backlog.fix: Resolved automatically when vitest is upgraded to ^5.0.3 (transitive dep).

backlog.title: jest@29.7.0 ecosystem — Multiple High-Severity Vulnerabilities
backlog.detail: Multiple high-severity issues in jest-message-util, jest-environment, jest-snapshots and other jest@29 ecosystem packages. Resolved by upgrading jest.
backlog.fix: npm install jest@^30.5.2 in Source/Backend (also resolves DEP-001 Handlebars cluster)

backlog.title: Dual logger import paths in workItemStore.ts
backlog.detail: Imports { logger } from '../utils/logger' (named, raw interface) instead of default from '../logger' (wrapper). Different interface signatures; if object-first calls are made, they will silently fail.
backlog.fix: Change import to: import logger from '../logger'

backlog.title: Traceability enforcer doesn't scan portal/ — 60+ FRs have no automated gate
backlog.detail: inspector.config.yml source.dirs only includes Source/. Portal has 60+ FRs (dev-workflow-platform.md) with no automated traceability enforcement.
backlog.fix: Add 'portal/' to source.dirs in inspector.config.yml and to traceability enforcer scan paths

backlog.title: eslint-disable suppressions without documented rationale
backlog.detail: react-hooks/exhaustive-deps suppressed without explaining which dependency is intentionally excluded and why. Common source of stale-closure bugs in recently-modified files.
backlog.fix: Add one-line comment above each eslint-disable explaining the intentional omission, e.g. // refreshKey is a trigger, not a value dependency
